## Project papers & preprints

The three project papers below are generated automatically from
[`bib/knight-project.bib`](https://github.com/CODE-ORNL/knight-site/blob/main/bib/knight-project.bib)
by `scripts/gen_project_papers.py`, which regenerates `_project-papers.qmd` on
every render/preview (wired up as a project `pre-render` hook in
`_quarto.yml`). Edit the `.bib` file and re-render -- no need to touch this
page.
